facts.business: Aanandalakshmi Spinning Mills Limited operates a spinning division and a land plotting division.

auditor.name: M/s. K.S.Rao & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: 1. The Company has not provided for the interest Payable on non-remittance of Tax Deducted at Source aggregating to Rs. 20.98 Lakhs (previous year Rs. 17.68 Lakhs). Consequent to the above the profit for the year is overstated by Rs. 3.30 Lakhs and current liabilities are under stated by Rs. 20.98 Lakhs. 2. As of March 31, 2026, the company has certain long pending Trade payables aggregating to Rs. 136.57 Lakhs of which the period of limitation is already expired as per the Limitation Act, 1963. In the absence of sufficient evidence, we are unable to determine whether any adjustments required to be made to the accompanying financial statements in respect of the said Payables.

key_risks: Non-provision of interest on TDS default leading to overstatement of profit and understatement of liabilities
Long pending trade payables beyond limitation period with uncertain adjustment requirements
